name: bugforge
description: BugForge: the forge skills for Claude, which build, audit and improve web apps

plugins.name: bugforge
plugins.description: Build, audit and improve web apps with Claude, at the level you pick from 1 (Subtle) to 5 (Cinematic): research, plan, design with three moving concepts and a 3D scene kit, build, check (tests and a security gate), improve and launch. Every change shows on your own localhost. A go per phase, or auto mode.
